text:
maria_tidewell: Hi Redwood team  We're Tidewell Health. Requesting onboarding for a bespoke "Domain Classifier" that tags claim notes and flags potential PHI leakage. Must run in Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS/HSM. We also need exportable eval metrics for entity-level F1 and a short enablement runbook.

leo_success: Welcome Maria! Quick clarifying q: is the model a fine-tune on an open foundation model or a closed-source binary? Also do you need a Dedicated pool SLA or is best-effort fine for now?

maria_tidewell: Fine-tuned on an Llama-derivative (13B). We can provide a labeled, redacted eval set (~1800 examples). Target: entity F1 >= 0.90; p95 latency target 250ms. Need logging/audit for key ops.

dan_eng: We can do private deployment with HSM-backed KMS. For 13B and p95=250ms we'd recommend 3xA10G dedicated nodes with batching tuned off for low tail latency. We support ONNX/ggml/torchscript artifacts. Any preference?

maria_tidewell: Prefer ONNX int8; artifact sitting in our S3. Transfer will need NDA and secure transfer instructions. Also want a small fallback policy to route <10% traffic to a smaller 7B during heavy load.

rachel_security: Security checklist: SOC2 attestation, privacy policy, model provenance, redaction steps for eval upload, and confirmation that no training data will be ingested by Redwood. Please upload artifacts only via our secure intake link.

intake-bot: Ticket created: CS-2026-912 "Tidewell: Domain Classifier private onboarding". Intake link: https://redwood-internal.example/intake/CS-2026-912

leo_success: Proposed onboarding milestones: 1) Intake + NDA & secure transfer (3 business days), 2) Security review (up to 7 days), 3) Perf & eval runs on staging dedicated pool (2-4 days incl. soak), 4) Canary rollout + enablement session (1 week). We'll capture renewal-risk indicators in the SOW.

dan_eng: For eval, please include: canonical prompt templates, gold entity spans/labels (strict spans), and expected post-processing rules. We'll run entity-level F1, span-overlap tolerance, and a 24h soak to estimate token cost and cache warmup. Example config we can spin up:

```
deployment: private
nodes: dedicated-3xa10g
model_artifact: s3://tidewell/domain-classifier-13b-onnx-int8.tar.gz
quant: onnx-int8
batching: disabled
logging: audit=true, keywrap=hsm
rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
fallback: domain-7b-distilled
```

maria_tidewell: Thanks Dan. We'll upload the redacted eval + SOC2 link by EOD and share NDA contact. A couple of questions: 1) cost estimate for the perf stage? 2) renewal terms (we usually do quarterly reviews) and risk triggers if perf drops.

leo_success: Cost for perf stage depends on run length; rough ballpark for staging perf + soak on 3xA10G is ~$6k for the run. We'll provide an itemized POC quote. Renewal triggers we'll outline: if sustained <50% of committed throughput for 30 days or rolling accuracy drop >5% vs baseline, that flags a renewal review.

rachel_security: Also confirm we will not accept raw PHI in eval uploads. Please redact per our guide and provide hashing/sampling proof in the intake form.

ops-bot: Board updated: Onboarding -> NDA signed, Secure transfer pending, Security review queued, Perf eval scheduled.

leo_success: Next steps: I'll send calendar invites for intake call (30m) tomorrow 11am PT. Dan will be on the tech call and Rachel for security. We'll use the intake ticket to track artifacts.

maria_tidewell: 11am PT works. Attendees: Maria (product), Priya (ML lead), Marco (infra). One final ask: can Redwood capture customer feedback during POC via a short 5-question survey after enablement? We want to loop that into renewal decisions.

leo_success: Yes, we'll attach a post-enablement survey and include feedback as part of the health dashboard. Looking forward to the call. :thumbsup:

maria_tidewell: Great, see you tomorrow.
